lede: The sculpture trail is outdoors and open to visitors. Please treat it gently — the art lives in the weather.

items.label: Where
items.value: Shutesbury, Massachusetts, on the Bright Water Bog Loop.

items.label: Hours
items.value: The outdoor trail is best in daylight — dawn to dusk.

items.label: Parking
items.value: A small gravel lot at the trailhead holds about eight cars; an accessible raised path leads in from there.

items.label: The land
items.value: The 147 acres around Ames Pond are conserved by Kestrel Land Trust, who maintain its five miles of trails as the Bright Water Bog Nature Retreat.

items.label: Please
items.value: The trail is outdoors; the home is private. Stay on the marked path and follow the trail signs.
